currentParagraphText: “A lone hunter, I see. Perhaps that is also why you wished to face me in single combat. Very well, the two of us shall duel, and upon my victory, I shall offer you to the One Beneath,” he spoke, Jake realizing that he had kind of just confirmed he was on his own, though, in his defense, he assumed the Warlord already knew. Then again, all the Warlord had to go on were reports, and it was entirely possible the apes who had fled the battle just hadn’t seen anyone else that Jake was with.

finalResult.nextParagraphText: What they had for certain seen was his level and the fact he was C-grade, which wasn’t anything Jake had tried to hide. Quite the opposite. He was more than happy to make his foe overconfident, believing Jake was weaker than he truly was.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: The Warlord kept glancing around himself, clearly expecting an attack to arrive at any point. His expression had slightly changed, though, as the Warlord looked even more confident now.
